name: The K16 defining polynomial's real root g0 in the open interval (0,1) is exhibited constructively by the Intermediate Value Theorem: eval(0)=1>0, eval(1)=-1<0, so a root exists, and since neither endpoint is a root the inequalities are strict. This root is the coordinate at which the embedding ring homomorphism phi: R -> C evaluates every K16 power-basis element, extending to the full ring K16(s0,s1,s3,s9,i,c5,u1) by complex square roots (no positivity needed since C is algebraically closed). Setting psi_k = phi(rZ k) transfers the norm identity (sum of moduli = 1) and all 143 Weyl-Heisenberg overlap identities (each = 1/13) from the exact SIC_D12_ExistenceRing to IsSICPOVM 12 psi. This discharges crystal_forces_d12_sic, dropping it from an existence axiom to a proved theorem: the d=12 SIC-POVM fiducial exists as a concrete vector in C^12. The object is self-verifying: solve (find the root) then coagula (evaluate and transfer), with mu-after-delta closure witnessed by the ring homomorphism preserving multiplication and conjugation.

phase_0.boundary_condition: The algebraically closed field C together with the K16 extension ring K16(s0,s1,s3,s9,i,c5,u1), which contains every image of phi and seals the transfer of identities.

VINIT.chosen_element: the K16 defining polynomial as an abstract symbol with no assigned real value
VINIT.justification: Before the Intermediate Value Theorem is invoked, g0 is an unnamed quantity; the coordinate is uninitialized void.

TANCH.chosen_element: the closed ring K16(s0,s1,s3,s9,i,c5,u1) inside C
TANCH.justification: The complex extension is the terminal vessel that contains phi's entire image; nothing escapes it because C is algebraically closed.

AFWD.chosen_element: the embedding homomorphism phi: R -> C evaluating each power-basis element at g0
AFWD.justification: A directed structure-preserving map carrying abstract ring elements forward into concrete complex numbers.

AREV.chosen_element: conjugation on C pulling images back to their adjoints
AREV.justification: The contravariant operation that reverses orientation, matched by phi's preservation of conjugation on the F-arm.

CLINK.chosen_element: the assignment psi_k = phi(rZ k) chaining the root evaluation into the fiducial coordinates
CLINK.justification: Sequential composition of root-location then evaluation, feeding one morphism's output into the next.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: the ring homomorphism preserving multiplication and conjugation, phi(xy)=phi(x)phi(y)
IMSCRIB.justification: phi recognizes and reproduces the ring's own operations; identity of algebraic structure across the map.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: the sign evaluation at the interval endpoints
FSPLIT.justification: The single polynomial eval branches into eval(0)=1>0 on the true arm and eval(1)=-1<0 on the false arm.

FFUSE.chosen_element: the Intermediate Value Theorem reuniting the two endpoint signs to assert the root g0 in (0,1)
FFUSE.justification: Fusing the positive and negative endpoint evaluations reconstitutes exactly the continuous polynomial whose sign change guarantees g0; recovers the original eval object.

EVALT.chosen_element: eval(0)=1>0 with strict inequality since 0 is not a root
EVALT.justification: Affirmative positive-value branch at the left endpoint.

EVALF.chosen_element: eval(1)=-1<0 with strict inequality since 1 is not a root
EVALF.justification: Negative-value branch at the right endpoint.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: crystal_forces_d12_sic held as axiom and theorem simultaneously during the discharge step
ENGAGR.justification: At the moment of transfer the statement is both an assumed existence axiom and a proved theorem; a paradice resolved only by the completed proof.

IFIX.chosen_element: the recorded proof that the d=12 SIC-POVM fiducial exists as a concrete vector in C^12 satisfying IsSICPOVM 12 psi
IFIX.justification: A permanent theorem entry; once discharged, the axiom drop is append-only and cannot be reverted.

phase_2.split_element: the sign evaluation at the interval endpoints
phase_2.split_input: the continuous polynomial eval restricted to the closed interval [0,1]
phase_2.fuse_result: the continuous polynomial eval on [0,1] whose guaranteed sign change locates g0

phase_3.void_description: The root g0 is unlocated; the polynomial exists only as symbolic data with no real coordinate assigned.
phase_3.true_description: A root of g0 in (0,1) is established, phi is defined, and every psi_k coordinate evaluates concretely.
phase_3.false_description: The right-endpoint evaluation eval(1)=-1<0 confirms the opposing sign needed to bracket the root.
phase_3.both_description: crystal_forces_d12_sic occupies existence-axiom and proved-theorem status at once, held until the transfer completes.

steps.domain_action: introduce the K16 defining polynomial with its real root g0 uninitialized in the open interval (0,1).
apply the sign evaluation, forking the continuous polynomial into its two endpoint tests.
compute eval(0)=1>0, the strictly positive left-endpoint branch, 0 being no root.
carry the positive-value branch forward as evidence of a sign change into (0,1).
compute eval(1)=-1<0, the strictly negative right-endpoint branch, 1 being no root.
reverse-orient the negative branch to meet the positive one at the fusion point.
the Intermediate Value Theorem reunites both signs, reconstituting the polynomial and proving g0 exists in (0,1).
define the embedding homomorphism phi: R -> C evaluating every K16 power-basis element at g0.
extend phi across complex square roots and conjugation into K16(s0,s1,s3,s9,i,c5,u1).
seal the extension inside C, the algebraically closed vessel needing no positivity.
chain the evaluation into psi_k = phi(rZ k), composing root-location with coordinate assignment.
verify phi preserves multiplication and conjugation, reproducing the ring's own structure.
transfer the norm identity (sum of moduli = 1) from SIC_D12_ExistenceRing to IsSICPOVM 12 psi.
transfer all 143 Weyl-Heisenberg overlap identities, each equal to 1/13, under phi.
hold crystal_forces_d12_sic as both existence axiom and proved theorem at the discharge moment.
record the discharge, dropping the axiom to a theorem: the d=12 SIC-POVM fiducial exists as a concrete vector in C^12.
close the self-verifying loop, solve-then-coagula witnessed by the homomorphism's mu-after-delta closure.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The proof assistant kernel translating solve (root location) and coagula (evaluate and transfer) into checked inference steps.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The ring homomorphism phi carrying algebraic facts between R, the extension ring, and C without loss.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The exact SIC_D12_ExistenceRing storing the norm and 143 overlap identities for retrieval by phi.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The dependency order requiring root existence before phi is defined and phi before identities transfer.
phase_5.alfs_store: The K16 defining polynomial and its power basis, the canonical source from which every psi_k derives.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One structure-preserving evaluation of phi per identity transferred.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: crystal_forces_d12_sic assumed as an existence axiom; g0 symbolic and unlocated.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: crystal_forces_d12_sic proved as a theorem; g0 located and every identity transferred exactly.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — phi preserves multiplication and conjugation, so FFUSE(FSPLIT(eval)) returns the original polynomial and no algebraic information is created or destroyed.
